title: The Sacraments: Baptism and Holy Communion

flashcard_questions.q: A holy ritual through which believers receive God's grace, regarded as an outward sign of an inward spiritual blessing.
A Christian ceremony using water as a sign of purification and admission into the Church.
A Christian service in which bread and wine are shared in memory of Jesus's Last Supper with his disciples.

flashcard_questions.a: A ceremony in which a baby is baptised with water, welcomed into the Church, and cleansed from original sin.
The sinful state that all humans are born into as a result of Adam and Eve's disobedience in the Garden of Eden.
